phase_0.boundary_condition: The multiplicative monoid modulo N with the chosen base orbit closed under the period map contains the full method, and the factor pair recorded at the end seals it.

⊢.justification: Void state where N stands alone and no base has been named.

⊣.chosen_element: verified factor pair p times q equals N
⊣.justification: Closed boundary that seals the method once multiplication of the pair returns N.

≻.chosen_element: modular advance map x to a times x mod N
≻.justification: Directed orbit step that builds the residue walk forward.

≺.chosen_element: division step back along the orbit
≺.justification: Reverse walk that returns along visited residues toward the seed.

⋈.chosen_element: orbit to order to factor chain
⋈.justification: Sequential chaining that links one orbit step to the next and the order to the factor split.

⊙.chosen_element: period fixed ray of the orbit map
⊙.justification: Self recognition where the orbit returns to its seed and names its own period.

∈.justification: Opens the orbit into an even order arm and an odd order arm with distinct continuations.

∋.justification: Rejoins the even and odd arms into the single orbit record for the tested base.

⊤.chosen_element: order even with nontrivial gcd reading
⊤.justification: Affirmative arm where the order yields candidate factors.

⊥.chosen_element: order odd or trivial gcd reading
⊥.justification: Negative arm where the base gives no factor and renewal is required.

⊞.chosen_element: order reading that both divides and renews
⊞.justification: A paraconsistent holding where one residue orbit supports a factor on one arm and demands a new base on the other.

⊡.justification: Permanent append only record of the verified prime pair whose product is N.

phase_2.split_input: modular exponentiation orbit of base a modulo N
split_outputs: even order arm carrying factor candidates
odd order arm carrying base renewal signal
phase_2.fuse_result: modular exponentiation orbit of base a modulo N
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: No base chosen and no orbit walked.
phase_3.true_description: The tested base gives even order with a nontrivial divisor of N.
phase_3.false_description: The tested base gives odd or trivial order and no factor follows from it.
phase_3.both_description: The orbit where one base both yields a factor and calls for another base on a distinct residue class, held together.

steps.domain_action: name N as the modulus to be divided without naming any base
select base a coprime to N and step the orbit a times x mod N
read the return of the orbit to its seed as the period fixed point
open the orbit into even order arm and odd order arm
on the even arm form a to r over 2 minus 1 and plus 1 and take gcd with N
on the odd arm mark the base as barren and name its renewal signal
hold the crossing residue where both arms stay live without forcing either shut
chain orbit walk to period read to gcd split to factor check
walk back along residues to confirm the period divides the orbit length
rejoin both arms into the orbit record for the tested base
seal the pair p and q once p times q equals N by the kernel check
fix the verified prime pair into the permanent record with command lines quoted

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The twelve axis frame that turns base selection and orbit reading into nest commands.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Residue values pass along CLINK links from orbit walk to order read to gcd split.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The crystal record and the orbit table hold residues, orders, and tried bases.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Possession check first, then basin read, then nest run, then fuse record.
phase_5.alfs_store: The kernel oneshots order finder with nesting and ovm belnap as reference tables.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One orbit walk per base plus one fuse per split, counted in kernel nest steps.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Modulus N undivided with base orbit unmeasured.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Order r fixed and factor pair recorded in the vessel record.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the cycle permutes residues and records the reading without erasing the orbit table.
